verdict.rationale: AMD documents SDK-level APIs (ONNX Runtime EP, CVML C++ API, server interface supporting C#, JS, Python, C++) for driving Ryzen AI hardware/software stack, which is meaningful public API documentation for an AI-native developer. However there is no REST/OpenAPI-style public API (probe confirms 404 on openapi.json/swagger.json), and no independent/hands-on corroboration of third-party integration via these APIs. Missing for 10: a formal machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI/REST), independent evidence of real-world API-driven integrations beyond first-party docs.
